news.title: The M&A Playbook of the AI Economy - by Sebastian Amieva
news.snippet: # The M&A Playbook of the AI Economy. A few weeks ago, I analyzed ***the $4.5 tr...
news.raw_snippet: # The M&A Playbook of the AI Economy. A few weeks ago, I analyzed ***the $4.5 trillion M&A 2025 to show that it wasn’t random dealmaking. Every transformational transaction in 2025 fits one of three strategic archetypes,*** and each one maps directly to how the AI economy is being built. The three archetypes are Infrastructure Consolidation, Platform War, and Talent Extraction. ***Archetype 1: The Infrastructure Consolidation Play***. Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern are in talks for a **$250 billion transcontinental rail merger**—the kind of deal that would create the dominant network spanning the entire United States. **It’s an infrastructure sovereignty play.** The combined entity would control the physical backbone that moves goods, energy, and materials across the continent. The same consolidation logic is playing out in AI infrastructure, just at even larger scale. **Amazon’s Trainium chips** are an escape route from the “NVIDIA tax.” Every custom silicon project—AWS Trainium, Google TPU, Microsoft’s Maia—represents a strategic decision that infrastructure dependence is an existential risk.
